name: Picture cache
responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown. A picture is of a board of one vault, so its key names the vault, and a listing forgets only the stale pictures of the vault it lists. A picture read against a named variant is another picture, so its key names that variant.

outgoing.label: include the comparison in the picture cache key
